## About
Ramon Mora grew up working in his father's commercial tire shop in Nogales, AZ. He learned the trade of servicing commercial tires there and brought that legacy to San Jose, where he opened Ramon's Commercial Tire on Stone Avenue.
We're a family owned business. We know time is of the essence when your truck or rig is down, so we work to keep the wait as short as we can.
Our customers rate us 4.8 from 72 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Commercial Tire Sales: Tires for big rigs, trucks and trailers. One reviewer said Ramon ordered special tires for her trailer quickly.
- Commercial Front-end Computerized alignments: Computerized front-end alignments for commercial trucks, done here at the shop.
- Commercial Mobile Alignment unit available: Our mobile unit brings electronic wheel alignment to your commercial trucks. Call us for details.
- Mounts and Dismounts: Tires mounted and dismounted on commercial wheels, from big rigs and trailers to motor homes, tractors and fork-lifts.
- Tire Repairs: Repairs on commercial tires so your truck, trailer or equipment can get back to work.
- Aluminum wheel polishing: Rim polishing and refurbishment to bring tired aluminum wheels back to a clean shine.
- Motor home tire sales: Tires for motor homes, with motor home valve-stem kits available too.
- 24-hour commercial roadside service available: Stuck on the road with a commercial vehicle? Give us a call, day or night.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: All commercial vehicles, including big rigs, trucks, trailers, motor homes, tractors and fork-lifts.

Q: What if I break down after hours?
A: Call our 24 hour emergency line at 1 (408) 426-7265.

Q: How can I pay?
A: All forms of payment are accepted. A 3.75% charge is applied to credit or debit card sales.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, the shop is closed Saturday and Sunday. We're open Monday through Friday.

## What customers say
- "I brought my Winnebago Solis to Ramon’s Commercial Tires in June 2025 in prep for a long trip to Alaska starting in late July. It had been a very busy year and I still had many demands on my time that were not related to the trip, and I was stressed.

I wanted new tires plus a spare for the trip. Savio at Leales referred me to Ramon’s and they did a wonderful job with the tires, including locating a rim for the spare.

The Solis has no space for a spare. I ordered a mounted from Landed Gear and had it shipped to Leales and Leales followed the instructions for the installation so that the spare stayed put even when we drove the famously rough Alcan Highway there and back.

The road is built on permafrost and its reputation has not been exaggerated - we encountered one car with two flat tires - but with good tires and slow driving, we never needed our spare. We also did not experience the problems I’ve read people have with other brands or improperly installed back door mounted spare tire racks:  broken window or warping of the metal doors." (Vicky Schulman, 5/5)
- "Called Ramon's and I'm sure glad I did.....last place I took my RV to they did tires sure...but they didn't really know how to work on an RV....heavy duty RV tires and all.......so after talking with Ramon on the phone I knew I picked the right place.  If you own an RV you need to go see this guy.  He knows the ins and outs of what can happen if you did not know what to look for......he changed out my crappy extensions on the rear RV tires to what he recommends ....moved good tires I had still around to other wheels and put on brand new Hankooks....I'm really happy with his service....quick....reliable....just a straight shooter.  He even saw that I had two good tires still since they were from 2015 and told me I did not need to replace.  Some tires the tread is fine and all but the tread sidewall is cracked and can end up doing some serious damage to your RV.....like major damage $$....this guy Ramon can show you what's up on your rig plus he's honest and now my go to guy if I ever need to replace my RV tires" (Falcone Coins, 5/5)
